content.title: Incentive Withdrawal Guide
content.description: Learn how to withdraw your generated Network Incentives as cryptocurrency or to your bank account using the Unetwork web management panel.
requirements: Active Unetwork account with earned incentives
Minimum $5.00 USD (5 UPs) available for withdrawal
Valid crypto wallet address (for crypto withdrawal)
Bank account details (for bank transfer withdrawal)

steps.title: View Your Dashboard
steps.description: From your Unetwork dashboard, you can see your Total Network Incentives and earnings summary. This shows your cumulative rewards, today's earnings, and last 7 days performance. Navigate to the Withdrawals section from the sidebar menu to proceed with your withdrawal.

steps.title: Access Withdrawals
steps.description:
In the Withdrawals section, you can view your Redeemable Incentives (available to withdraw) and Total Incentives earned. The page shows your Previous Withdrawals history with transaction details and status. Click the 'Withdraw Incentives' button at the bottom to start a new withdrawal.

**Note:** The minimum withdrawal amount is $5.00 USD (1 UP = $1.00 USD).

steps.title: Enter Withdrawal Details
steps.description:
On the Claim Incentive page, fill in your withdrawal details:

- **Amount**: Enter the amount you wish to redeem (or click 'Max' for full balance)
- **Wallet Address**: Enter your destination crypto wallet address
- **Payout Type**: Select your preferred blockchain network (Ethereum, Binance Chain, Solana, Ripple XRP, or Cardano)
- **Asset**: Choose the cryptocurrency asset (BNB, USDT, or USDC)

**Important:** Enter a valid crypto address. Crypto sent to the wrong address cannot be recovered. Ensure you are using the correct network and a secure wallet.

steps.title: Confirm Your Withdrawal
steps.description:
Review your withdrawal details in the confirmation modal:

- **Quote expires in**: Time remaining to confirm (the exchange rate is locked for this duration)
- **Amount**: The USD amount being withdrawn
- **Fee**: Transaction fee (if any)
- **Asset**: The cryptocurrency you selected
- **Asset Amount**: The exact amount of crypto you will receive

Click 'Confirm' to complete your withdrawal. The transaction will be processed and you can track its status in your Previous Withdrawals list.

steps.title: Bank Account Registration (Optional)
steps.description:
If you prefer to withdraw directly to your bank account instead of crypto, navigate to the 'Bank Account Registration' tab. Select your Country of Residence from the dropdown menu. Available regions include:

- **Asia**: India, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam
- **Africa**: Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Egypt
- **South America**: Brazil

**Note:** Changing your country will reset the form. Make sure to select the correct country before proceeding.

steps.title: Enter Banking Details
steps.description:
After selecting your country, complete the Bank Account Registration form with your details:

- **Full Legal Name**: Enter your name exactly as it appears on your bank account
- **Account Currency**: Select your local currency (e.g., PHP - Philippine Peso)
- **Account Type**: Choose Personal or Business
- **Banking Details**: Enter your bank account information including bank name, account number, and any required routing codes

Once registered, you can withdraw your incentives directly to your bank account.
